movelist.name: Leech Life
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains HP equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Endure
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a damaging Move, you may use Endure as a Free Action. If the Move would bring Endure’s user down to 0 Hit Points or less, Endure’s user instead is set to 1 Hit Point.

movelist.name: Vital Throw
movelist.effect: If the user is targeted by a Melee attack and has not yet taken a turn this round, the user may declare Vital Throw. After the triggering attack is resolved, the user may use Vital Throw against the triggering foe as a Reaction. Vital Throw cannot miss.

movelist.name: Bulk Up
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.effect: The user receives +1 Combat Stage in their highest non-HP stat.

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.effect: Ghost Types are not immune to the user’s Normal and Fighting-Type Moves.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.effect: The user may use a self-targeting Status-Class Move as a Free Action.
